Today I went for a dental scaling using my Gold Card privileges. It didn't cost me anything at all.

The staff at the counter were very kind, polite, and provided excellent service.
I told them I was using my Gold Card privileges, and they provided excellent service. They were very kind.

The dentist did a great job with the scaling. It wasn't painful or sore at all. He also did a thorough dental exam, checking for cavities and tartar buildup. I really enjoyed it.

If you're considering coming here, I highly recommend it. It's excellent! 🥰

I went for a teeth cleaning yesterday using my government health insurance card. The counter staff were very polite and provided excellent service. Inside the room, the assistant and the dentist were also excellent. The teeth cleaning was painless. This was my first time using their service.
Please make an appointment in advance.

The doctor provided excellent service and advice. The procedure was very gentle and painless. The staff were also very helpful. It's recommended to make an appointment in advance for convenience. The location is easy to find, near the Phukham intersection. The place is spacious, and you can park in front of the clinic. They accept the National Health Insurance (Gold Card) and Social Security, so no upfront payment is required.
Excellent! The admin handled the appointment process very well, responded quickly, and was very kind.
I got my dental work done using my government dental insurance. No long queues. The dentist gave excellent advice. The staff were polite and lovely.

It's a very good place, highly recommended. The place is clean and spacious.
